item.title: Shredding Event coming to Mount Forest - 88.7 The River
item.description: CrimeStoppers Guelph Wellington will host their annual Shredding Event in Mount Forest next Saturday.For $10, participants can get a banker’s box worth of documents shredded, with all proceeds going to CrimeStoppers Guelph Wellington.The event runs from 9 a.m. to noon in the parking lot of the Mount Forest Fire Department on Main Street.
